shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Standard plunge into the 007 top lanes. Before your very first ball, pull the gun trigger during the opening animation for one of a dozen hidden endings.

shots.name: Ball Saver Magnet
shots.notes: A magnet at the outhole that catches a draining ball and flings it back into play. It works on outlane drains too. It is also the mechanism behind Eject or Die.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Lit for Eject or Die once you have finished Shootout. There is no kickback on this machine, so Eject or Die is the only outlane insurance you get.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Two switches sit here. The upper one is the one that raises the Pop-Up Ramp when a Satellite shot is available. The Far Left Ramp is the reliable way to get a ball rolling through it.

shots.name: Shootout Bank
shots.notes: Three large white standups on the lower left. Completing all three in single-ball, non-mode play lights the small yellow target between them.

shots.name: Shootout Target
shots.notes: The small yellow target tucked into the Shootout bank. Hitting it while lit starts Shootout, which is the gateway to Eject or Die.

shots.name: Far Left Ramp
shots.notes: A shallow ramp that feeds the left inlane, which makes it the standard set-up shot for the Satellite. It can be backhanded, and it is a jackpot shot in both multiballs.

shots.name: Ramp Standups
shots.notes: Two green targets flanking the Lock Ramp entrance. With the four on the Satellite bank they make up the six Guard targets. A drain straight off the right one is compensated with a ball save.

shots.name: Lock Ramp
shots.notes: Feeds the right inlane and awards a Virtual Lock when lit. Also backhandable, also a jackpot shot, and the finishing shot of the Nerve Gas Plant mode.

shots.name: Center Eject Target
shots.notes: The large mirrored standup in the middle of the playfield. It collects extra balls, lights Virtual Locks and Tank Multiball, and it is the target that keeps you alive during Eject or Die.

shots.name: Mode Start Lane
shots.notes: A short lane ending in a kickout hole, easiest from the right flipper. Starts 007 Encounters, collects Mystery, is a jackpot shot, and is where the wizard mode begins.

shots.name: 0-0-7 Top Lanes
shots.notes: Three rollovers across the back. Completing them advances the bonus multiplier and is one of the five wizard mode requirements. There is a long delay between lanes and none of them count during multiball.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers (3)
shots.notes: 250K a hit. In non-mode single-ball play they cycle which 007 Encounter is lit. There is no spinner on this machine, so the bumpers are also the fastest switch source in the game.

shots.name: Satellite Bank
shots.notes: Four green Guard targets. Completing all six Guard targets in single-ball play pays the current Satellite Value.

shots.name: Satellite Value Target
shots.notes: The white target in the Satellite bank. It toggles the value that the Guard award and the multiball jackpots pay: 10M unlit, then 25M, 50M, 75M and 100M.

shots.name: Pop-Up Ramp
shots.notes: A steep ramp that rises out of the playfield in front of the Satellite bank when the left inlane triggers it. The ball flies off the end and, if you are lucky, sticks to the dish.

shots.name: The Satellite
shots.notes: A large rotating dish with a magnet at its centre. A ball that lands on the magnet stays there until the game lets it go or another ball knocks it off.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: A long ramp that loops the whole playfield. Depending on speed it drops into the bumpers, loads the tank, or feeds the left inlane. On some machines a hard shot hops the return into the right outlane.

shots.name: Q Targets
shots.notes: Down in the lower right corner sits a pair of standups, one white and one blue. Three hits on the white one starts Q's Pen. If you cannot hit them cleanly, glance the ball off the bottom of the Shootout bank and let it deflect across.

shots.name: Collect Bonus Lane
shots.notes: A short lane above the right inlane that runs into the plunger lane. Rolling it during single-ball play cashes your multiplied bonus on the spot.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Roll it and the Mode Start Lane arms for Mystery, though only for a few seconds. Free points if you follow it up immediately.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Lit for Eject or Die after Shootout. The Right Ramp return can occasionally hop straight into it without touching the outlane switch.

goals.title: Complete 0-0-7
goals.summary: Three rollovers across the back. Completing them advances your bonus multiplier, and doing it once is one of the five things standing between you and the wizard mode. There is a noticeable delay between lanes and none of them register during multiball.
goals.reward: Bonus multiplier, and a wizard requirement

steps.action: Take what the plunge gives you
steps.detail: A plunged ball rolls the lanes for free, and that is by far the easiest way to collect them.

steps.action: Otherwise feed the bumpers and hope
steps.detail: The only other route into the lanes is a bumper kicking the ball up one, so do not leave 0-0-7 for ball three.

goals.title: Spell GOLDENEYE
goals.summary: Ramp shots in single-ball, non-mode play spot letters in GOLDENEYE below the display. The last few letters start flashing as you close in. It is worth spelling for its own sake, and it is a wizard mode requirement.

steps.detail: Only in single-ball play with no 007 Encounter running.

steps.action: Alternate ramps for combo value on the way
steps.detail: The letters do not care which ramp you use, but the combo award does.
Completing GOLDENEYE immediately starts hurry-ups on all three ramps.

goals.title: The GOLDENEYE Hurry-Ups
goals.summary: Spelling GOLDENEYE pays 10M and lights all three ramps for hurry-ups. Each starts at 50M and bleeds a million a second down to 20M before it expires. Collect all three and the left inlane arms the Satellite for one more shot that pays your hurry-up total over again.
goals.reward: Up to roughly 320M for the full sequence

steps.detail: Every second you spend deciding costs you a million on each of the three.

steps.action: Roll the left inlane after the third ramp
steps.detail: That raises the Pop-Up Ramp, and the window is short.
The Satellite pays your hurry-up points plus 10M a second time. This is the single biggest scoring sequence in the game outside multiball.

goals.title: Ramp Combos
goals.summary: In single-ball, non-mode play each ramp arms another one for a combo. Take the Far Left or the Right Ramp and your follow-up is the Right Ramp; take the Lock Ramp and both the Far Left and the Lock Ramp come alive. Combo one pays 10M, and every unbroken link after that adds a further 2M.

steps.detail: It relights itself, so you can keep looping the same shot if it is the one you can hit.
The value resets to 10M the moment you miss, so a clean sequence is worth far more than scattered ramps.

goals.title: The Six Guard Targets
goals.summary: Four green targets on the Satellite bank and two more flanking the Lock Ramp. Clearing all six in single-ball play pays the current Satellite Value, which is anywhere from 10M to 100M depending on how you set it.

steps.action: Set the value before you finish the set
steps.detail: The white target in the bank toggles the award through 10M, 25M, 50M, 75M and 100M.
These are the awkward half of the set, sitting up beside the Satellite.

steps.action: Pick up the two by the Lock Ramp
steps.detail: A near miss on the Lock Ramp usually catches one of these anyway.

goals.title: Set The Satellite Value
goals.summary: One white target controls how much a large part of the game pays. It cycles the value through 10M, 25M, 50M, 75M and 100M, and that number is both the Guard award and the jackpot value in both multiballs. Set it to 100M before you start anything.
goals.reward: Jackpots and Guard awards worth up to 100M

steps.detail: Each hit steps the value one notch. It is the cheapest scoring decision on the machine.

steps.action: Remember Guard hits cycle it in multiball
steps.detail: During Tank Multiball, hitting any Guard target changes the jackpot value, so a stray hit can cost you 90M.

goals.title: Virtual Locks
goals.summary: The Lock Ramp is what banks a Virtual Lock, but it only counts while lit — and the Center Eject Target is what lights it. Two Virtual Locks open Satellite Multiball. The cost escalates: one Center Eject hit each for your first two multiballs, two for the third.

steps.detail: The big mirrored target in the middle of the playfield is the switch for this.
Two of these and Satellite Multiball is armed.
With multiball lit, the upper left inlane switch is what puts the ramp up for your shot at the dish.

goals.title: Satellite Multiball
goals.summary: The good one. Jackpots at your Satellite Value light up on both ramps, on the Right Ramp and at the Mode Start Lane. Sweep all four while two or more balls are still alive and the Pop-Up Ramp arms for a 200M shot that knocks the stuck ball off the dish.
goals.reward: Jackpots to 100M, a 200M dish shot, 150M Super

steps.action: Stick a ball on the dish to start
steps.detail: The Pop-Up Ramp has to land the ball on the magnet at the centre of the Satellite.
Both ramps, the Right Ramp and the Mode Start Lane, all paying the Satellite Value.

steps.action: Knock the ball off the dish
steps.detail: Complete all four jackpots while at least two balls are alive and the ramp raises for a 200M shot.
The 150M Super Jackpot cycles between the four shots on its own; after it, the four regular jackpots relight.

goals.title: Tank Multiball
goals.summary: The lesser multiball. Same four jackpot shots, same values, but no Satellite payoff. You can cancel it outright by pulling the gun trigger during the opening animation, which keeps Satellite Multiball lit for later.
goals.reward: Four jackpots at the Satellite Value, relit on completion

steps.detail: With Satellite Multiball already lit, a Center Eject hit lights the Right Ramp for Tank Multiball, and a second hit lights the Mode Start Lane too.

steps.action: Do not touch the Guard targets
steps.detail: Any Guard hit cycles the jackpot value, which is how people end up collecting 10M jackpots instead of 100M ones.
Drain down to one ball without a single jackpot and the Right Ramp restarts Tank Multiball for about twenty seconds.

goals.title: Shootout
goals.summary: The mode nobody solves on their first try. Three guards appear and you are told to shoot — but not with the ball. The machine has a gun on the front. Six trigger pulls, two per guard, and you are done.

steps.detail: This only counts in single-ball, non-mode play.

steps.action: Hit the small yellow target to start it
steps.detail: It sits between the second and third white targets.

steps.action: Now use the trigger, not the flippers
steps.detail: Six pulls of the gun trigger finishes it, the shots climbing 2M, 4M, 6M, 8M, 10M — and Eject or Die lights up once that last one lands.

goals.title: Eject Or Die
goals.summary: There is no kickback on this machine, so Shootout is your ball save. With Eject or Die lit, an outlane drain during single-ball play gets caught by the magnet and thrown back out — and a six-second clock starts. Put the ball into the Center Eject Target before it expires, or that really is the end of the ball.
goals.reward: A saved ball, or a lost one

steps.detail: Each Shootout you finish banks another Eject or Die, and they carry across balls until used.

steps.action: Drain an outlane with it lit
steps.detail: It only works in single-ball play. Centre drains and multiball drains leave it lit for next ball.
Six seconds is roughly one attempt. The timer does stop while the ball is in the bumpers. Do not rush more than you have to.

goals.title: Mystery
goals.summary: Roll through the right inlane and Mystery arms at the Mode Start Lane for a couple of seconds. It is cheap and it is fast. Be aware that the 2X award does not spot the 0-0-7 lanes toward the wizard mode requirement.

steps.detail: Only counts during single-ball play with no 007 Encounter running.
The light is only on for a few seconds, so this is a shot you take on reflex.

goals.title: Xenia Extra Ball
goals.summary: The only extra ball in the whole game. The Center Eject Target lights for a hurry-up and one hit ends the mode with an extra ball in the bank. If a mode comes up and this one is available, take it over anything else.

steps.detail: The bumpers rotate which 007 Encounter is lit, but only while you are down to one ball with no mode running.
The mode start kickout has a short ball save behind it.
One hit and the extra ball is yours. Do not start this one while Eject or Die is live.

goals.title: Satellite Hurry-Up
goals.summary: A 007 Encounter built on one shot. The value opens at 90M and drops 5M at a time until it bottoms out. Rolling the left inlane is what puts the Pop-Up Ramp in position, so the real problem is getting a ball through that inlane quickly.

steps.action: Use the Far Left Ramp as your feed
steps.detail: It is the most reliable way to put a ball through the left inlane.
The upper of the two inlane switches is the one that arms it.
One shot ends the mode. A ball that sticks right as the timer dies does not always pay.

goals.title: Nerve Gas Plant
goals.summary: Clear all six Guard targets and then make the Lock Ramp inside thirty seconds. The first target is 25M, the second 20M, the rest 15M each, and the finishing ramp is 30M. It is a lot of work for a mode, but a clean run is worth well over 100M.

steps.action: Start with the four up top
steps.detail: Targets you have already hit only pay 1M on a repeat, so sweep, do not grind.

steps.action: Pick up the two by the ramp
steps.detail: These two are conveniently on the way to your finishing shot.

steps.action: Close it out on the Lock Ramp
steps.detail: 30M, and it has to be inside the thirty-second window.

goals.title: Train Encounter
goals.summary: A two-ball 007 Encounter with a ball save at the start. The Far Left Ramp begins lit; making it lights the Right Ramp, which relights the Far Left, and so on. Shots pay 30M, 25M, 20M, 15M and 10M — so the first two are the ones that matter.

steps.detail: The Far Left Ramp is always the first shot of this encounter.
The tank swallows every Right Ramp shot and spits it out at the right inlane, which is how each ramp keeps setting up the other.

goals.title: Send Spike
goals.summary: Thirty seconds to link cities on the world map. Two shots count — Lock Ramp, Right Ramp — and each one loops, so settle on whichever you hit cleanest and keep feeding it instead of alternating.
goals.reward: Points per lit ramp for 30 seconds

steps.action: Pick one ramp and stay on it
steps.detail: Each lit ramp advances you two cities along the map.

steps.action: Or use this one if it is your better shot
steps.detail: There is no bonus for alternating here, unlike the Train encounter.

goals.title: Q's Pen
goals.summary: The white Q target has to be hit three separate times in single-ball, non-mode play just to start the mode. Then you get fourteen seconds to hit the Q bank three more times, for 10M, 20M and 30M. Finishing it is a wizard requirement, and it is the one most players are missing.

steps.action: Hit the white target three times to arm it
steps.detail: Unlit, then lit, then blinking, then the mode starts.

steps.action: Three more hits inside fourteen seconds
steps.detail: A hit made with only a second or two left buys you a brief extension.

steps.action: Bank the shot if you cannot hit it clean
steps.detail: From the right flipper, a deflection off the bottom of the Shootout bank will carry the ball across into the Q targets.

goals.title: The Wizard Checklist
goals.summary: Five separate boxes have to be ticked, in any order, before the Mode Start Lane will light for the wizard mode. You will know it is ready when all five mode indicators start flashing at once.
instructions: Start and end all five 007 Encounters. You do not have to complete any of them — starting and finishing is enough.
Complete the 0-0-7 top lanes at least once. Do this early, because after ball one the only way in is a lucky bumper kick.
Finish Shootout, which means using the gun trigger, not the ball.
Successfully complete Q's Pen — all three target hits inside the fourteen seconds. This is the usual missing piece.
Spell GOLDENEYE with ramp shots in single-ball, non-mode play.
Starting the wizard mode should be your goal for the whole game — the modes only become available again after it, and the only extra ball in the game lives inside one of them.

goals.title: The Wizard Mode
goals.summary: Every ball on the playfield with little or no ball save. Switches are worth 3M each and ramps 20M — but the number that matters is fifty: every fifty switch hits adds another ball into play. Keeping balls alive beats shooting ramps.
goals.reward: 3M per switch, 20M per ramp, a new ball every 50 switches

steps.action: Start it once all five requirements are done
steps.detail: The five mode indicators flash together when it is ready.
There is no spinner on this machine, so the bumpers are the fastest way to bank switch hits toward the next added ball.

steps.action: Take ramps when they are safe
steps.detail: 20M is real money, but not at the cost of losing a ball — the mode ends the moment you are down to one.

goals.title: Novice Mode
goals.summary: A pre-game choice most players never see. When the game starts you have eight seconds to pick Novice Mode instead of a regular game. Novice gives you unlimited balls for two full minutes, after which your next drain ends the game.
instructions: Choose within eight seconds of starting the game — leave it and a regular game is selected for you.

For the first two minutes nothing you drain counts against you. Once that clock expires, the very next ball you lose ends the game — the only reprieves are a banked extra ball or an unused Eject or Die.
It is the fastest way to learn the layout and the shot angles without feeding the machine.
Holding a flipper while pressing Start selects other game types, though they change little in normal play.

goals.title: Bonus And Collect Bonus
goals.summary: Your base bonus is a flat million for every ramp shot plus every Mode Start Lane shot you made, multiplied by the 0-0-7 multiplier. The Collect Bonus lane above the right inlane cashes it mid-ball, which is worth knowing when you are sitting on a big multiplier.
goals.reward: 1M per ramp and lane shot, multiplied

steps.detail: The bonus is invisible during play — you only ever see the final product.

steps.action: Cash it when it is fat
steps.detail: The lane only pays during single-ball play, and it feeds straight into the plunger lane.

achievements.title: Shoot To Kill
achievements.desc: Work out what Shootout actually wants and finish it.

achievements.title: Eject
achievements.desc: Survive an Eject or Die by hitting the Center Eject Target in time.

achievements.title: All Three Ramps
achievements.desc: Collect all three GOLDENEYE hurry-ups and finish on the Satellite.

achievements.title: Maximum Value
achievements.desc: Set the Satellite Value to 100M before starting a multiball.

achievements.title: On The Dish
achievements.desc: Land a ball on the Satellite magnet to start Satellite Multiball.

achievements.title: Two Hundred Million
achievements.desc: Knock the ball off the Satellite during multiball for the 200M award.

achievements.title: Q Branch
achievements.desc: Successfully complete Q's Pen inside the timer.

achievements.title: Five Of Five
achievements.desc: Tick every wizard mode requirement in one game.

achievements.title: For England
achievements.desc: Start the wizard mode at the Mode Start Lane.

drills.title: Set The Value First
drills.text: The white target in the Satellite bank steps the award through 10M, 25M, 50M, 75M and 100M, and that same number is the Guard award and both multiballs' jackpots. Push it to 100M before you start anything, then keep off the Guard targets during Tank Multiball, because any hit cycles it back down.

drills.title: Bank Into The Q Targets
drills.text: The white Q target needs three separate hits just to arm the mode, and it sits in the lower right corner where a clean shot is awkward. Practise the deflection off the bottom of the Shootout bank from the right flipper, which carries the ball across into it.

drills.title: Clear The Bank, Then Use The Trigger
drills.text: Take the three white standups in single-ball play, then the small yellow target tucked between them. When the guards appear, stop flipping — six pulls of the gun trigger finishes it, and that is what banks your only outlane save.

drills.title: The Six-Second Recovery
drills.text: With Eject or Die lit, an outlane drain gets caught by the magnet and thrown back out, and you have six seconds to put the ball into the Center Eject Target — roughly one attempt. Drill that shot from wherever the magnet leaves you, and remember the clock stops while the ball is in the bumpers.

drills.title: Unbroken Ramp Chain
drills.text: Far Left or Right Ramp arms the Right Ramp; the Lock Ramp arms both itself and the Far Left. Run chains without a miss, since the value resets to 10M the moment one drops and the Lock Ramp relighting itself means you can keep looping the shot you own.

drills.title: Decide The Ramp Order First
drills.text: The three hurry-ups all bleed a million a second, so pick the order before the sequence starts rather than deciding on the fly. After the third ramp, roll the left inlane to raise the pop-up ramp and land the dish while that short window is still open.

actionButton.label: Gun Trigger
actionButton.location: a gun mounted on the front of the cabinet
actionButton.how: GoldenEye bolts a gun to the front of the cabinet and its trigger is a genuine control, not a prop. It is dead through ordinary play, but there are three moments where pulling it is the right move — and in one of them it is the only move that works.

uses.when: Shootout, three guards on the display
uses.what: Six pulls, two per guard, ends the mode. Flipping does nothing. The kills climb 2M, 4M, 6M, 8M, 10M.
That completion is what lights Eject or Die at both outlanes — the only outlane insurance on a machine with no kickback.
Pull to cancel it outright. Satellite Multiball stays lit, and that is the one with the 200M payoff.

uses.when: Opening animation, before your first plunge
uses.what: Pull as Bond turns and you trigger one of about a dozen hidden endings — a cow, a T-rex, a falling pinball machine.
Nothing at all. Keep both hands on the flippers outside those windows.

howItPlays.objective: Run Bond through five 007 Encounters, arm the dish and its hundred-million jackpots, and tick the five boxes that open the wizard mode. A gun bolted to the cabinet, not the ball, is what beats Shootout and lights your only outlane save.
loop: Plunge to roll the 0-0-7 lanes for free, then step the white dish target up to its top value before you start anything that pays it.
Light the lock ramp at the mirrored center target and bank two virtual locks to arm Satellite Multiball.
Spell GOLDENEYE on single-ball ramp shots to trigger three hurry-ups, then cash them a second time on the dish.
Start and finish all five encounters, clear the top lanes, beat Shootout with the trigger, and win Q's Pen to light the wizard at the mode-start hole.

lights.name: 0-0-7 Top Lanes
lights.lit: The three back rollovers spell 0-0-7 and step your bonus multiplier each time you finish them; a plunged ball rolls them for nothing, which is by a mile the easy way in.
lights.then: Complete the trio to lift the bonus and check off one of the five doors to the wizard -- but do it on ball one, because a long gap between lanes and a total blackout in multiball leave a bumper kick as your only other route. Cash the bonus itself at the short lane above the right return once the multiplier is fat.

lights.name: Satellite Value Target
lights.lit: One white target in the dish bank sets the number a huge slice of the game pays -- it steps from a floor figure up to a full hundred million, and that same figure is both the Guard award and every multiball jackpot.
lights.then: Knock it to the top before you launch a multiball or clear the guards, since this one target controls all of it. Mind the flip side: any Guard hit during Tank Multiball nudges the value, so a careless shot can knock a jackpot down by ninety million.

lights.name: Six Guard Targets
lights.lit: Four green targets crowd the dish and two more flank the lock ramp; together they make the six guards, and a target you have hit stays down until the whole set is done.
lights.then: Sweep all six in single-ball play to collect whatever number you set the dish value to. The same six are the meat of Nerve Gas Plant, where you clear them and close on the lock ramp inside the clock for a large single-ball haul.

lights.name: Virtual Locks
lights.lit: That big mirror-faced standup in the center of the field is the switch that lights the lock ramp; a made lock ramp while lit banks a virtual lock, and the price climbs -- a center hit apiece for the first two, then two for the third.
lights.then: Bank two locks to arm Satellite Multiball, then raise the pop-up ramp with the upper left-return switch to fling a ball onto the dish magnet and start it. That center target pulls double duty as your extra-ball collect and your lifeline during Eject or Die.

lights.name: Multiball Jackpot Shots
lights.lit: In either multiball, jackpots light at four shots for your dish value -- the far-left ramp, the lock ramp, the long right ramp and the mode-start hole -- while the dish payoff itself belongs only to the satellite version.
lights.then: Sweep all four before you are down to your last ball and the pop-up ramp rises for a two-hundred-million knock at the stuck dish ball, after which a roving super circles the four shots on its own. Tank Multiball runs the same four with no dish reward, so keep it lit and save the satellite start for the real money.

lights.name: GOLDENEYE Ramp Letters
lights.lit: Ramp shots taken in single-ball play with no encounter running spot the letters of GOLDENEYE under the screen, and the last few blink as you close on the word.
lights.flashing: Those final letters flash when the word is nearly spelled; it does not matter which ramp lands them, though alternating ramps banks combo value along the way.
lights.then: Finish the word for a flat award and three ramp hurry-ups that open high and bleed away a million each second. Take all three, then roll the left return so the pop-up ramp lifts and stick the dish for a payout of your whole hurry-up total over again -- the biggest scoring string outside of multiball.

lights.name: Eject or Die Outlanes
lights.lit: With no kickback anywhere on this machine, your outlane net is Eject or Die, and only finishing Shootout arms it -- a mode you win with six pulls of the cabinet gun rather than the flippers.
lights.then: Once it is lit, an outlane drain in single-ball play gets snatched by the outhole magnet and flung back out with a six-second clock ticking. Put the ball into the center target before it expires to stay alive; each Shootout you bank stacks another save, and they carry across balls until spent.

scoring.text: Roll the 0-0-7 lanes off the plunge while they still come easy, and push the white dish target to its top value before anything pays it. Bank a Shootout with the trigger so Eject or Die is armed on a machine that gives you no other outlane help.

Light the lock ramp at the center target and bank two locks for Satellite Multiball, the good one. Spell GOLDENEYE for its hurry-up string, and grind out Q's Pen -- the box most players are missing on the road to the wizard.

Tick all five wizard boxes -- every encounter started and ended, the top lanes cleared, Shootout beaten, Q's Pen won and GOLDENEYE spelled -- to light the wizard at the mode-start hole. There each ball floods the field and every fifty switch hits pumps another ball in, so surviving beats aiming.
